import {test}from'node:test';import{readFile}from'node:fs/promises';import{isolatedDeposit}from'../support/h4-deposit-isolated.ts';import{f06Migration}from'../support/h4-019-current-chain.ts';
test('F15 technical driver reproduction ordinary role denied migration, pool transaction cleanup',async()=>{const g=await isolatedDeposit('crm_f15_pool',57212);try{const sql=await readFile('supabase/migrations/'+f06Migration,'utf8');try{await g.runtime.unsafe(sql);}catch(e){console.log('F15 migration denial',JSON.stringify({message:(e as Error).message,code:(e as any).code}));}await g.runtime.unsafe('rollback');console.log('F15 backend states',JSON.stringify(await g.admin`select pid,state,backend_xid::text xid,query from pg_stat_activity where datname='crm_f15_pool' and usename='crm_h0_runtime'`));for(let i=0;i<8;i++){try{await g.runtime.begin(async tx=>await tx`select 1`);console.log('F15 begin PASS',i);}catch(e){console.log('F15 begin FAIL',JSON.stringify({i,message:(e as Error).message,code:(e as any).code}));}}}finally{await g.close();}});
